Markets.title: Vedanta dividend alert! Last day to buy shares of Anil Agarwal-led company for Rs 5/share dividend
Markets.summary: Today is the last day to buy Vedanta shares to be eligible for its upcoming interim dividend of Rs 5 per share. This payout marks the company's first dividend since its mega demerger earlier this year and totals Rs 1,955 crore.

Markets.title: TCS dividend alert! Last day to buy IT major's shares for Rs 12 dividend
Markets.summary: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) has announced an interim dividend of Rs 12 per share for the September quarter. Investors must purchase the IT major's shares by today to be eligible for this payout.

Markets.title: HD Fire Protect IPO opens today; GMP signals 30% listing gains, key details inside
Markets.summary: The Rs 712.31-crore HD Fire Protect IPO opened today with a Grey Market Premium indicating 30% listing gains. The offering is entirely an offer for sale, meaning all proceeds will go to selling shareholders rather than the company.

Markets.title: Positive Breakout: These 7 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
Markets.summary: Seven stocks have crossed above their 200-day moving averages. This technical milestone generally indicates that these equities are now in an overall uptrend.

Markets.title: Oil Price Today (October 13): Crude oil falls to $105 as traders assess Russian supply, Mideast attacks. What’s next?
Markets.summary: Crude oil prices fell about one percent, with Brent dropping to $105 a barrel and WTI declining to $93 a barrel. Prices have still surged over 70% this year due to the US war on Iran affecting global energy markets.

Markets.title: Dollar holds near 18-month high as geopolitical risks rise
Markets.summary: The US dollar index held steady at 102.56, supported by rising geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and Ukraine. Meanwhile, major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and ether experienced downturns amid these shifting market dynamics.

Geo-Political.title: Six Ukrainian energy sites hit by Russia since Trump announced ceasefire, Zelensky says
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Russia has struck six Ukrainian energy facilities since the U.S. president announced a ceasefire on targeting such infrastructure. Despite the reported agreement, Russian strikes against Ukraine's energy sites have continued.

Geo-Political.title: Why Moscow is staying tight-lipped on Trump's energy ceasefire
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has expressed openness to a proposed energy infrastructure ceasefire. Meanwhile, the Russian government has remained largely silent on the initiative.

Geo-Political.title: Documents falsified to evade tax on Abramovich's wealth, BBC finds
Geo-Political.summary: A BBC investigation found that Russian oligarch Roman Abramovich used backdated documents to evade taxes on his wealth. The falsified paperwork also removed his yachts and mansions from financial accounts.

Geo-Political.title: Saudi minister vows 'serious response' to Houthi attacks on airports
Geo-Political.summary: A Saudi minister promised a serious response after Houthi attacks on two airports killed 13 people. This incident represents a significant escalation in the ongoing conflict involving the armed group's strikes on Saudi facilities.

Geo-Political.title: Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte dies aged 34
Geo-Political.summary: Actor RJ Mitte, who played Walter White Jr. in the television series Breaking Bad, has died at the age of 34. Mitte was known for his role in the Emmy-winning drama and lived with cerebral palsy.

Geo-Political.title: South Africa's deputy police chief resigns after being charged with sexual offences
Geo-Political.summary: South Africa's deputy police chief, Shadrack Sibiya, has resigned following charges of sexual offenses, including grooming a 16-year-old and raping an 18-year-old. Sibiya has previously denied all of the allegations against him.

AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator found their WordPress SaaS course recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. Data & Insights.title: IMF raises India's growth forecast for FY27 and FY28 amid strong domestic demand, credits AI for helping world economy
Data & Insights.summary: The IMF upgraded India's economic growth forecast for fiscal years 2027 and 2028, driven by strong domestic demand. Additionally, the global financial agency raised its 2026 worldwide growth forecast due to higher-than-expected economic activity and artificial intelligence investments.

Data & Insights.title: Centre to review GST reforms with states, plug gaps ahead of April 2027 rollout
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is reviewing GST reforms with states to ensure proper implementation and business benefits ahead of an April 2027 rollout. Key proposals include removing GST officers' arrest powers and simplifying administrative procedures.

Data & Insights.title: India, UK to exchange tariff usage data under trade agreement
Data & Insights.summary: India and the UK will begin exchanging annual tariff usage data in July 2027 under their trade agreement. This initiative is designed to help small businesses benefit from lower import duties and overcome early operational challenges.

Data & Insights.title: US tariffs accelerate global trade realignment: How India’s FTAs could boost GDP
Data & Insights.summary: Bloomberg Economics reports that India's expanding free trade agreements could increase its GDP by $140 billion and boost exports by 6.2% by 2035. This projected growth is driven by changing global supply chains and new US tariffs that are accelerating international trade realignment.

Data & Insights.title: FTAs may add $140bn to India GDP by 2035, lift exports 6.2%: Bloomberg Economics
Data & Insights.summary: Free trade agreements could add $140 billion to India's GDP and boost exports by 6.2% by 2035, according to Bloomberg Economics. Those gains could increase to $170 billion if India successfully concludes ongoing trade negotiations with the US and other regions.

Data & Insights.title: India sees 5% drop in job postings in Q2, fares better than major economies: Bain & Company
Data & Insights.summary: India's job postings decreased by 5% year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026, though the country performed better than other major economies. Despite weaker entry-level hiring, global artificial intelligence job openings surged by 60% to approximately 351,000.

India.title: Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, 3 Other States Get New Governors
India.summary: Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and three other states have received new governors following a communique from the Rashtrapati Bhavan. Sikkim Governor Om Prakash Mathur will replace Arlekar as the new Governor of Kerala.

India.title: "Unconstitutional": Karnataka Court Quashes ST/SC Quota Exceeding 50% Cap
India.summary: A Karnataka court has struck down a state law that increased reservations for SCs and STs beyond the 50 percent constitutional limit. The court ruled that the enhanced quotas in government services violate Articles 14 and 16 of the Constitution.

India.title: Pak Handlers Behind Gang That Attacked Punjab Cop, Accused Shot While Escaping
India.summary: Amritsar Rural Police state that a jail inmate used a mobile phone to reconnect with Pakistani ISI handlers and form a criminal gang. This gang attacked a Punjab policeman, and one of the suspects was subsequently shot while attempting to escape.

India.title: Exclusive: Shashi Tharoor's Protest Post-Credits Mention Centre, Neha Bora
India.summary: Shashi Tharoor stated that AISA president Neha Bora was the main highlight of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protest. He credited her leadership in his exclusive post about the demonstration.

India.title: Jagtar Singh Hawara Could Be Out Of Jail Soon: Group After Meeting Bhagwant Mann
India.summary: A group claims Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann assured them the state will support moving Jagtar Singh Hawara to a Punjab jail during a Supreme Court hearing. This move could potentially lead to Hawara's release from prison soon.

India.title: Akali Dal's Big Focus On Women In Punjab, Through Drugs, Financial Help
India.summary: Akali MP Harsimrat Kaur Badal addressed a women's gathering in Bathinda to criticize the Bhagwant Mann government. She accused the state administration of failing to fulfill promises made to women and neglecting to stop drug trafficking.

General.title: Hundreds more prisoners to be freed in second phase of early release scheme
General.summary: Hundreds of additional prisoners will be released early under the second phase of a government scheme. This tranche applies to individuals who are serving sentences of up to two and a half years.

General.title: Why the prime minister wants to talk about Brexit again
General.summary: The UK currently has its first prime minister since leaving the EU who is willing to openly debate Brexit. According to the BBC's political editor, the prime minister wants to discuss the topic unflinchingly.

General.title: Heating oil customers face tough winter despite shake-up promise
General.summary: The government has promised better regulation for the heating oil sector to help customers facing soaring bills. However, these consumers still face a tough winter despite the promised shake-up.
